c: ServiceNow development is browser-bound: one form at a time.
say: ServiceNow work happens in the browser, one form at a time. Nobody gets a complete, searchable picture of what runs on a table.

c: Coding agents are blind to the instance.
say: Coding agents are now the fastest way to write code, but they can't see your instance. They duplicate what already runs, and they ignore platform practice.

c: Best practice is checked late, if at all.
say: Best practice is usually checked when an update set is reviewed, long after the code is written, if it is checked at all.

c: snagentic puts the whole instance in git, as files.
say: snagentic puts the whole instance in git, as files that you and your agent can read, search and review.

c: describe and find answer what runs when you save.
say: Ask why the assignment group changes when you save an incident, and get the answer in order, in about a second.

c: 41 rules and the push gate, enforced in code.
say: 41 platform rules check every change, and report only what that change introduced. They run in code, not in a prompt the agent can ignore.

c: Reviewed changes go to development. Production stays read-only.
say: Reviewed changes go to a development instance, as a normal update set. Test and production are read-only by construction.
